relations.text_en: Deere buys Deere-branded excavators, components and service parts from Hitachi under an agreement lasting 5 to 30 years

source.label: Deere & Company 10-K(2025-11-02)
source.quote: This deferred consideration will be paid as we purchase Deere-branded excavators, components, and service parts from Hitachi under the agreement with a duration that ranges from 5 to 30 years after the acquisition date.
